articles.body: An estimated 125,000 people, including more than 57,000 children, have fled since hostilities erupted in July between the Iran-backed Houthi rebels, the Yemeni government and its ally Saudi Arabia, with the UN calling it one of the most rapid and volatile waves of displacement in Yemen in years. articles.body: Since Donald Trump’s return to the White House in January 2025, migrant arrests have surged in the United States. More than 610,000 people have passed through detention centres run by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), the federal immigration agency in under two years. The pace only continues to accelerate: in August 2026, nearly 51,000 arrests were made in a single month – a record for Trump’s second term. Who are the people being held in these centres? What are their living conditions like? And how is Trump’s mass deportation policy upending the lives of families settled in the United States? In this report, Valérie Defert and Pierrick Laurent investigate the issue in Texas – the heart of the new US immigration detention system.
articles.headline: Fear and broken families: Inside a Texas ICE detention centre

articles.body: Alison Sargent is pleased to welcome Grégoire Roos, Director of the Europe and Russia and Eurasia Programmes at Chatham House. According to Roos, Russia’s parliamentary election is revealing because of what the electoral process can still tell us about the political system Vladimir Putin has constructed. In the absence of any meaningful competition, and anti-war opposition excluded, Roos argues that the most revealing signals may lie elsewhere: in turnout, the timing of voting, the performance of the remaining parties, and the Kremlin’s effort to frame participation itself as evidence of national unity.

articles.body: AI BILLS BILLS BILLS: One of the architects of New York’s pioneering legislation to put guardrails around artificial intelligence says ominous warnings from industry leaders prove states need to act aggressively. “I’m very rarely one to say, ‘I told you so’ or ‘We told you so,’ But this is exactly … the things we had warned about,” said Democratic state Sen. Andrew Gounardes, who sponsored the RAISE Act. The law is slated to take effect in January, requires the largest AI companies to report safety incidents to the state and establishes penalties for violations. New York lawmakers passed that bill last year, despite pushback from industry lobbyists. But now leading AI executives are ramping up warnings about the risks of their technology. “These are the exact same concerns that we were flagging: biological weapons, nuclear weapons, catastrophic harms,” Gounardes said in an interview with Playbook. “Not only were we right, but some of the very same people that were telling us that we were wrong are now the ones saying that we need to be doing these things.” President Donald Trump has dismissed AI safety concerns as a “HOAX” and Congress appears unlikely to act on the issue anytime soon. So lawmakers in New York and other states are weighing how they can respond. California Gov. Gavin Newsom has floated the idea of a special session devoted to the issue, but New York’s Legislature isn’t slated to return to Albany until January. Gounardes said he’s had an increasing amount of engagement with AI safety advocates, industry experts and others in recent weeks. He’s focused on two bills he’s sponsoring — one requiring third-party safety audits , similar to a measure enacted in Illinois , and another strengthening safety reporting requirements . “They're good bills, they're important bills, they should pass as is. But I think we can go further,” Gounardes said. There's a clear appetite among other key policymakers to pass more measures to bolster protections for New Yorkers. Gov. Kathy Hochul told reporters Tuesday she’ll be looking for additional action the state can take to reduce AI safety risks. State Sen. Kristen Gonzalez, chair of the Internet and Technology committee, said she plans to push for a “rights-based” framework and focus on potentially high risk uses of AI. Her bills for next year include a data privacy measure and the New York AI Act , which seeks to address concerns about algorithmic bias in employment, courts, finance and other contexts. That measure also includes whistleblower protections for employees of AI companies. New York Attorney General Letitia James today urged AI workers to report safety risks or violations of current state laws, offering an anonymous tip line . Gonzalez also has a bill pending on Hochul’s desk that would regulate AI chatbots and assign liability to companies who develop them. “There are so many bills, and together, if we were to pass all of these that track out liability, we would be able to actually start fighting these companies, not just through slowing their development … but also mitigating more in court and having a foundation to claim damages,” she said. — Marie J. French From the Capitol MERGER WATCH: The state Public Health and Health Planning Council voted today to approve a merger between NYC Health + Hospitals and Maimonides Health, a private hospital in Brooklyn. "We all need to get behind this and make it work," PHHPC member Ann Monroe said during today’s meeting. The merger was set into motion last year, after Hochul awarded $2.2 billion from the state-funded Safety Net Transformation Program to facilitate the deal. Maimonides has for years relied on substantial state support to keep its doors open, and state health officials expressed optimism that the combination would stabilize the hospital's finances. The transaction was expected to close by April 1, but a judge ruled earlier this year that NYC Health + Hospitals and Maimonides first needed to obtain PHHPC’s approval. Read the full story from POLITICO Pro's Maya Kaufman FROM CITY HALL PENSION PADDING: Several top officials from former Mayor Eric Adams’ administration are raking in inflated NYPD pensions that should be lowered, a report from New York City’s corruption watchdog recommended Thursday. The Department of Investigation report revolves around the use of so-called 821 waivers under the Adams administration. The waivers allow NYPD employees to be “on loan” to other agencies, including the mayor’s office, so they can maintain a police title that comes with pension benefits while working in another capacity. In its report, DOI found the NYPD documented the waivers in an inconsistent way during Adams’ tenure, resulting in the city’s Police Pension Fund awarding overly large retirement benefits to former cops who served in top roles under Adams. But the watchdog agency determined the NYPD wasn’t squarely to blame for this, given that the pension fund also seemingly ignored 821 restrictions “in a manner inconsistent with the law.” The DOI findings come after a string of corruption scandals roiled the Adams administration and the NYPD. Adams himself faced federal corruption charges in 2024 before President Donald Trump’s Department of Justice stepped in to spare the former mayor from prosecution . The DOI’s latest findings don’t allege criminal wrongdoing, but the report lays out a number of recommendations for how the NYPD and the pension fund can prevent similar missteps. It also calls for all the allegedly inflated retirement benefits to be recalculated so the former cops in question aren’t getting taxpayer-funded benefits that are overly generous. Among the former NYPD cops who netted padded pensions are Kaz Daughtry, who served as Adams’ deputy mayor for public safety; Louis Molina, Adams’ commissioner of correction and citywide administrative services; and Juanita Holmes, Adams’ probation commissioner. “NYPD officials were treated inconsistently and some received a higher pension than they would otherwise have been eligible for, with taxpayers footing the bill,” Department of Investigation Commissioner Nadia Shihata said. “Those pensions should be recalculated and adjusted properly.” Read the full story from Chris Sommerfeldt in POLITICO . PREDICTED PROTESTS: NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch said today she expects “multiple protests every day” next week as the city hosts the United Nations General Assembly. No credible security threats have been identified, she noted, though the department will remain on high alert. “The NYPD, as you know, handles thousands of protests and demonstrations each year, and there is no organization better trained to facilitate First Amendment activity,” Tisch said at a press conference with Mayor Zohran Mamdani. “Every year around the UN General Assembly time, we do see an uptick in the amount of protest activity, and this year I do not expect to be any different.” The NYPD did not provide specific details on the number of protest permits filed or the exact number of demonstrations expected. Some of the largest and most tumultuous protests are expected to take place ahead of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s speech on Sept. 24. Despite his strident anti-Israel rhetoric, Mamdani plans to skip next week’s protests, Chris Sommerfeldt first reported yesterday. When asked why he’s staying away, Mamdani cited a desire to focus on New Yorkers’ day-to-day transportation concerns during the assembly, which will cause significant traffic disruptions and road closures in Midtown. Mamdani will not skip the UN proceedings altogether, though. He said he’s in the process of setting up meetings with foreign officials in town for the assembly, but did not elaborate on which ones. His press team did not immediately share any further details either. — Molly Reinmann IN OTHER NEWS — POINTING FINGERS: Some City Council members blamed Mamdani for a crime spike in the Bronx. articles.body: Democratic consultants are privately encouraging their battleground candidates to avoid talking about artificial intelligence regulations out of fear that powerful tech groups will unleash a tidal wave of spending against them ahead of November. That guidance came from strategists in three separate top-tier House races, according to people involved in those races, who were granted anonymity to discuss internal conversations. And it follows a surge in AI panic on Capitol Hill as industry leaders warn about existential threats posed by their rapidly developing technology. Voters are increasingly worried about AI: About two-thirds of Americans say there’s a risk advanced AI could destroy humanity in a new POLITICO Poll. President Donald Trump has called that concern a "hoax," leaving an opening for Democrats to seize on the issue. But they still are grappling with how hard to go after big tech. Senior Democrats and candidates are worried that if they go too hard in criticizing AI, industry-affiliated super PACs could drop millions more dollars against them , according to interviews with more than a dozen Democratic lawmakers and strategists. They are especially worried about a slate of competitive races, including Reps. Don Davis in North Carolina, Marcy Kaptur in Ohio, Henry Cuellar in Texas and a handful of South Texas and Pennsylvania races, getting hit with even more spending on topics like AI. The party is already struggling to keep up in the outside spending battle as Trump and his allies including Elon Musk , a major AI investor, flood the airwaves, though Musk’s spending isn’t primarily driven by AI concerns. “We do need to be able to make sure that we’re regulating [AI] and addressing those real fears,” said one senior Democratic strategist working on Senate campaigns, who was granted anonymity to candidly discuss strategy. But “we don’t want AI money coming in.” “Like any industry, there should be a conversation about guardrails,” said Cuellar, who is trying to hold onto a GOP-leaning South Texas seat. “But, every member needs to make their own decision based on their district and beliefs.” Rep. Pramila Jayapal, the former Progressive Caucus chair, said she was also worried that pro-AI groups will start targeting key Democrats. “You know, these AI groups — they come out and they say that they're concerned, that they want regulation. But then they spend huge amounts of money on defeating anybody who wants legislative regulation,” Jayapal said in an interview. With AI regulation on congressional Democrats’ agenda if they take power next year, Jayapal said AI groups will be “spending for candidates that they can count on to just allow them to write the bill.” Some top Democratic candidates and their campaigns are quietly trying to avoid crossing any red lines for tech super PACs — even as it’s unclear exactly what those lines would be, after Musk and two of the biggest AI CEOs called for more regulation on the technology last week. Democrats are especially wary of Leading the Future, a pro-AI industry super PAC that spent over $25 million in primary races this year and is backed by investors and executives of OpenAI. The rival super PAC network, Public First Action, pushes for AI regulation and is funded by OpenAI’s chief competitor, Anthropic. Asked by POLITICO, Leading the Future declined to name a specific policy on AI it opposes. “The only people that have both threatened and carried out spending and intimidation tactics against Democratic members of Congress over their positions on AI are Public First and other groups funded by Anthropic and effective altruists,” said Leading the Future spokesperson Josh Vlasto. “Our agenda is and has always been Congress passing a strong and smart national regulation which has broad and building support in Congress and across the country.” On Wednesday, Leading the Future launched its first round of ads in the general election through its Republican PAC. The group is spending $2 million to boost GOP Senate candidates Julia Letlow in Louisiana, Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi, Sen. Darline Graham in South Carolina and Sen. Mike Rounds in South Dakota — four Republicans in marginally competitive races that are unlikely to determine Senate control. The two AI groups have been at odds. They spent in different primary races and went up against each other in the primary for retiring Rep. Jerry Nadler’s seat, where state Assemblymember Alex Bores’ AI-centered campaign ignited a spending war . A person familiar with Leading the Future’s strategy, who was granted anonymity to discuss internal deliberations, told POLITICO in June that the group was unlikely to target another candidate this year with the kind of multi-million dollar negative ad deluge it dumped on Bores, and a person close to the group said that hasn’t changed. Democrats believe the groups could battle against each other again in key races. Brad Carson, the co-founder of Public First Action, said the network will “absolutely” get involved in the general election. Public First Action uses two “litmus tests” to weigh whether or not to jump into races, Carson said. If someone seeking office shows “strong support for export controls and strong opposition to the preemption of state laws regarding AI, absent a federal framework,” then they are a prime candidate to receive the group’s support. And if a candidate were to hold the opposite position — opposition to export controls and support for the preemption of state laws — his group would be inclined to jump in and spend against them. “It's really about finding the people who want to step out and be heroes for you,” Carson said. On Wednesday, Anthropic’s policy chief Sarah Heck said at POLITICO’s Decoded summit that the United States “needs to stay in the lead on AI” over China, arguing “you can’t do safety from second place.” She agreed AI firms can’t be left on their own to ensure safety within their own companies, but declined to endorse bipartisan legislation for external regulation. Some Democrats want to go hard on regulating AI in spite of the risk of antagonizing pro-industry groups. Abdul El-Sayed, Democrats’ Senate nominee in Michigan, previously called for a regulatory crackdown on AI and is now advocating for a “full pause at the frontier of research.” He told POLITICO in an interview on Wednesday that he’d “rather be on the truth than dodge [AI industry] money.” Still, El-Sayed hasn’t committed to running ads on the issue. Battleground Democratic Reps. Susie Lee (Nev.) and Greg Landsman (Ohio) also told POLITICO they weren’t planning ads on AI safeguards, even as they advocate for more regulations. It’s a sign that even as voters concerns’ rise about the technology, it’s not yet become a top issue for the November election. Meanwhile, Republicans are hoping that the AI super PACs might come in and help boost them in other states — like Georgia, where Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff has been aggressive in criticizing the industry, or Texas, where the GOP nominee, Attorney General Ken Paxton, has been slightly behind in most recent polls.“We could use the help in some races like that,” said one GOP senator, granted anonymity to candidly discuss the internal conversations.
articles.headline: Democratic advisers are warning their candidates not to go too hard at AI

articles.body: NEW YORK — Vice President JD Vance will hit a key hurdle in his fence-mending effort with Jewish Republicans on Thursday when he hosts a popular conservative radio host at the White House. 77 WABC host Sid Rosenberg, a longtime friend and ardent ally of President Donald Trump, has publicly attacked Vance for maintaining a friendship with Tucker Carlson, the former Fox News personality accused of invoking antisemitic tropes in criticizing Israel. Rosenberg, who’s known for making inflammatory remarks , has also taken aim at Vance for what he sees as the vice president’s lack of commitment to a “strong” U.S. alliance with Israel. In an interview Wednesday with POLITICO, Rosenberg said he plans to grill Vance in person about both Carlson and U.S. aid for Israel at a meeting he described as coming at Vance’s request. And while he said the main purpose of Thursday’s meeting is to get to know Vance, he noted that he’ll raise his concerns to the vice president in the context of his most pressing political priority: his likely 2028 run for president. “If he really wants to win in ‘28, he has no choice but to, at the very least, distance himself from [Carlson] if not completely disavow him,” Rosenberg said, adding that he believes the vice president “has pissed off the Jews and many Trump supporters.” Describing distrust of Vance in right-leaning Jewish communities as “a big problem,” Rosenberg said he’ll ask the vice president to commit to steering clear of Carlson and continue significant U.S. support for Israel if elected president. “I hope I can get some of those commitments. Do I think I can get it? I don’t know,” Rosenberg said. He added that he expects to meet with Trump in the Oval Office after his sit-down with Vance. As the front-runner for the Republican Party’s 2028 presidential nomination, Vance’s tense relationship with Israel’s supporters in the GOP could become a serious liability. Major Republican donors have already said they would be reluctant to financially boost Vance’s presidential run because of his views on Israel, a sharp departure from how Trump has held a commanding grip in that realm, thanks in large part to his alliance with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. In that light, Vance’s meeting with Rosenberg — who has known Trump since at least 2018 — takes on outsize significance. It also comes after Vance extended an olive branch earlier this month at the Republican Jewish Coalition’s leadership summit in Las Vegas, where he voiced concern about antisemitic hate crimes and said working with Israel is “in the best interest of the United States.” Vance touched on Carlson at that summit as well, acknowledging that “people in this room may disagree” with things he’s said, but the vice president avoided discussing his relationship with him . Just days after that appearance, however, Vance ignited criticism from pro-Israel Republicans again by saying in a speech that the U.S. cannot allow its Middle East policy approach to be “subservient to the State of Israel.” Asked about Rosenberg’s comments ahead of their White House meeting, a Vance spokesperson said Wednesday that the vice president would be meeting with the radio host after they didn't meet in Las Vegas. “The Vice President was unfortunately not able to meet with him in Las Vegas during the RJC Leadership Summit, and of course wanted to make time to meet with him in Washington,” the spokesperson said. Rosenberg, a former sports commentator who now runs his own political radio show “Sid & Friends in the Morning” in New York City, confirmed Vance’s team asked for Thursday’s meeting. And despite his concerns about Vance’s Israel posture, he called the vice president an “affable” and “smart” person who’s “capable of the job.” Still, Rosenberg made clear he doesn’t view Vance as the strongest Republican contender for president in 2028. “He’s not my first choice. I’m a Marco guy,” Rosenberg said, referring to Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who’s also rumored as a possible 2028 candidate. “If it turns out Marco doesn’t run, and JD wins the primary, in the end, if JD is the last man standing, I will support him.” Rosenberg’s influence remains mostly limited to the relatively small world of Republican politics in deep-blue New York. Still, his friendship with Trump has elevated him as a voice on the right, even as he’s attracted his share of controversy. In March, Rosenberg called Zohran Mamdani, New York City’s first Muslim mayor, an “America hating, Jew hating, Radical Islam cockroach" while voicing displeasure with Trump’s surprisingly cordial interactions with Mamdani. After drawing intense pushback from voices across the aisle, Rosenberg apologized to Mamdani for the harsh remark, saying it was a “bit over the top” and admitting it’s “not nice to call somebody a bug.” Rosenberg also came under intense fire earlier this year for calling Mamdani “a terrorist” — and apologized for that remark too. But he later retracted that apology , saying he was “exactly right” to use the term. With additional reporting by Alex Gangitano
articles.headline: JD Vance faces test in White House meeting with Israel-backing radio host

articles.body: JACOB’S LADDER: Otsego County Democratic Chair Caitlin Ogden is launching a bid for the top spot in the state party — the first time its current chair, Jay Jacobs, has had a challenger during his lengthy tenure. Jacobs, who also serves as Nassau County’s Democratic chair, has led the state party under the past three governors, with stints from 2009 to 2012 and 2019 through the present. But those stints have unfolded despite years of grumbling from the party’s progressive flank. “I came in as Otsego County chair about five years ago, and I’ve heard since then that Jay Jacobs has helped the party get by. And he definitely has,” Ogden said. “But I think the political landscape is shifting radically, and it’s time for a new leader to guide the party through the next phase and really deliver on Gov. Hochul’s vision of statewide, year-round party organizing.” The friendly footing toward Gov. Kathy Hochul is a bit of a shift for Ogden. She was a top supporter of Lt. Gov. Antonio Delgado’s challenge to the governor. But expanding on Hochul’s efforts to use the party to help candidates up and down the ballot is now the focus of Ogden’s message as she attempts to win over party members. The Democratic Party has indisputably played a larger role organizing campaigns across the state in recent years, though numerous local officials have characterized this as a slapdash operation that emerges only in the run-up to congressional contests. Ogden said that in 2022 she “had been expecting there to be a coordinated campaign structure because I had been told there would be.” “There was not in any capacity — there was no organizational help from Albany or the state party,” she said. “We never got any literature for any of our Albany candidates; we finally got 40 signs for Kathy Hochul in the middle of October.” The party apparatus has since been more helpful, Ogden said. But it’s still absent more often than not. It played no role as Democrats in her county had one of its best nights in history last November and has been quiet so far in the county that’s at the heart of Rep. Josh Riley’s battleground district. “We don’t even have staff hired yet, at least to my knowledge,” she said. “And it’s so late in the game.” “Is it something that would be helpful?” Jacobs said in response to Ogden’s call for a more regular statewide effort. “Of course.” “But the big question is ‘where do you get the money?’ We raise millions now: This coordinated campaign is going to run through between $6 and $8 million. And that’s not easy to raise, so speculating that you’ll be able to fund not only election year coordinated campaigns, but also ongoing coordinated campaigns year-round every year, I don’t think is reasonable.” Jacobs highlighted several accomplishments at the state party, such as a grant program that’s given $1 million to county committees and “allowing resolutions to come to the floor, where before they were always tabled to not allow for debate.” He also acknowledged that while 2022 was a “tough year” for the party, it did “very well” in 2024. The party’s elected committee members select the chair . But historically, they’ve just gone along with whomever’s picked by the governor — a potential obstacle to the pro-Delgado Ogden, but one she thinks can be overcome. “The conversation has been happening for a really long time now … about whether or not our leadership is on the right path,” she said. Jacobs has faced calls for his ouster after the 2021, 2022 and 2025 elections, and easily survived a vote of no confidence six years ago. There were rumors last fall that his tenure was at an end after he declined to endorse then-mayoral nominee Zohran Mamdani, but Hochul said he was “doing a great job” and the party stuck with him. “Since I’ve been the chair for ten years over two different tenures, I have heard repeatedly that I’m on the way out,” Jacobs said. “The only thing is, it’s never come from me.” “It’s not that I need it for my livelihood — I like being involved in the Democratic Party and I find this a worthwhile endeavor. So as long as that remains, I’m happy to continue.” The state Democratic Party will decide on Oct. 1 whether Jacobs stays on or not. — Bill Mahoney FROM CITY HALL ZO ON BIBI IN NYC: Mayor Zohran Mamdani spoke publicly for the first time today on his plans to skip the protests against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The Jewish head of state will be in New York City next week for the United Nations General Assembly. “I have made very clear about my views, my thoughts, my assessments,” Mamdani said when asked why he’ll sit out. “When it comes to the UN General Assembly, my focus is ensuring that our city remains prepared to host representatives from across the world, to keep New Yorkers safe, and also to ensure that we’re able to both address the global conversation and the very local concerns New Yorkers have about traffic and their ability to get from point A to point B over the course of the next week.” Mamdani’s nod to quotidian anxieties like gridlock is a far cry from his typically strident anti-Israel rhetoric and long history of pro-Palestinian activism. As recently as July, he was publicly railing against Netanyahu and entertaining the idea of having the NYPD arrest him on a controversial war crimes warrant issued by the International Criminal Court over Israel’s war in Gaza. The war, launched in response to Hamas’ Oct. 7, 2023 attack that killed about 1,200 Israelis, has left more than 73,000 Palestinians dead. Mamdani ultimately walked back his calls , saying in a social media video that his administration does not have the “independent legal authority to enforce this warrant.” Still, he has continued to condemn Netanyahu, whom he called the “architect of a horrific genocide.” And he has appeared to call New Yorkers to action, saying that, “while we cannot end the genocide on our own, we can decide whether our silence will become another weapon.” The mayor faced accusations that he was stoking antisemitism by continuing to talk about arresting Netanyahu despite knowing he lacked the power to do so . The mayor took a more measured tone today when answering questions about whether he would encourage critics of Israel to protest Netanyahu’s visit to the city. “To New Yorkers — I’ve never encouraged them to protest, but I always told them they have the right to do so, and we respect that right, and this city is proud of the first amendment,” Mamdani said. Regardless, sizable protests are expected ahead of and during Netanyahu’s Sept. 24 speech at the UN. The mayor said he has been in close contact with the NYPD and there are no expected security threats. — Molly Reinmann SEWER SOCIALISM: Mamdani’s administration plans to install 17 free public bathrooms across the five boroughs — part of a one-year, $4 million pilot project with the modular public toilet company Throne Labs. Each of the modular bathrooms will be climate controlled, have a toilet, a sink and a baby changing station, and will close at 10 p.m. To enter, New Yorkers can scan a QR code, use an app, send a text message, or use a physical tap card. “These 17 formerly bathroomless locations will soon become New York City’s number one place to go number two — or number one, you don’t need to tell me,” the mayor joked today. The pilot program is set to place five toilets in the Bronx, four in Brooklyn, three in Queens, four in Manhattan and one in Staten Island. The initiative builds on a January announcement from Mamdani and is an attempt to solve an enduring problem that’s bedeviled city officials for decades: How to construct a simple public restroom without taking years and spending millions of dollars. Former Council Member David Greenfield once highlighted a public restroom renovation in his district that — bogged down by municipal procurement and construction requirements — took nearly a decade and cost $2 million. The commodes announced by Mamdani today, by contrast, are projected to come out to under $250,000 per bathroom, inclusive of maintenance, for the year-long pilot. “We are essentially wasting taxpayer money,” Greenfield said at the time . “You can build a complete house in six months for $1 million.” — Molly Reinmann and Joe Anuta FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL EYES ON AI: Democratic Rep. Pat Ryan and former city Comptroller Brad Lander are among the signatories on a pledge to refuse cash from the big-money, pro-AI political group Leading the Future. Lander, who’s all but certain to serve in Congress next year after winning the June primary in a safe-blue district, said he’s “determined to pass strong safeguards into law and make sure the American people have a true say in the future of AI.” Ryan accused the “Big Tech oligarchs behind Leading the Future” of only caring “about their profits.” — an argument he made during the primary for NY-12 . In that race to succeed retiring Rep. Jerry Nadler, Ryan backed state Assemblymember Alex Bores, one of Leading the Future’s biggest targets . Bores finished in second place. The public condemnations from Ryan and Lander come amid heightened concerns about the existential threat potentially posed by AI. New York politicians have urged the federal government to do more to address the rapidly developing technology, and Hochul vowed that the state will fill the void in the absence of action from Washington. Leading the Future, which is backed by leaders at OpenAI and the venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz, has pushed back against criticism that it’s anti-regulation. It previously stated that it supports “passing a national regulatory framework for AI.” — Madison Fernandez IN OTHER NEWS — GRACIE GATHERING: Students and teachers from two of New York City’s elite Orthodox Jewish schools will demonstrate Friday outside Gracie Mansion. ( Jewish Currents ) — FLOWERY PLANS: City officials are weighing plans to put rain gardens on top of bus stops after a prototype went up in Brooklyn. ( Gothamist ) — PROPERTY PAYOUT: New York City is spending $60 million to settle a 2019 lawsuit alleging a city-instituted program illegally stripped dozens of homeowners of their equity. articles.body: <p>El PSOE busca cómo salvar el “vacío legal” planteado por el Tribunal Supremo de las devoluciones en caliente de quienes llegan a nado. El pasado 8 de julio, los magistrados confirmaron que el artículo de la ley de extranjería que regula el rechazo exprés no es aplicable para todos los extranjeros que intenten cruzar irregularmente la frontera por tierra o mar, sino solo “para aquellos que intentan hacerlo superando los elementos de contención fronterizos establecidos, como las vallas”. Es decir, el rechazo en frontera no aplica en el caso de entradas por agua si no hay un elemento físico de contención. Tres semanas después de la resolución, todo saltó por los aires con la avalancha de entre 70.000 y 80.000 personas que entraron <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/la-audiencia-nacional-permite-el-uso-temporal-del-campamento-de-migrantes-en-el-puerto-de-ceuta.html?mrfhud=true" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/la-audiencia-nacional-permite-el-uso-temporal-del-campamento-de-migrantes-en-el-puerto-de-ceuta.html?mrfhud=true">en Ceuta</a>, a quienes las fuerzas de seguridad <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-08/el-supremo-prohibe-las-devoluciones-en-caliente-de-los-inmigrantes-que-intentan-entrar-a-nado-en-ceuta-y-melilla.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-08/el-supremo-prohibe-las-devoluciones-en-caliente-de-los-inmigrantes-que-intentan-entrar-a-nado-en-ceuta-y-melilla.html">no podían retornar automáticamente obedeciendo al alto tribunal</a>. Ahora, los socialistas estudian una reforma de la ley para superar ese escollo normativo —que tras el cruce se solventó transitoriamente con la instalación de una boya de 500 metros—, según aseguran fuentes socialistas a EL PAÍS. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-18/el-psoe-estudia-una-reforma-para-salvar-el-vacio-legal-planteado-por-el-supremo-para-devolver-a-migrantes-que-entren-a-nado.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>Decenas de unidades de la Policía, unos 150 efectivos, trasladan este viernes a los migrantes asentados en la playa Benítez, al lado de El Trampolín, hasta los campamentos instalados en el puerto de Ceuta, después de que <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/la-audiencia-nacional-permite-el-uso-temporal-del-campamento-de-migrantes-en-el-puerto-de-ceuta.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/la-audiencia-nacional-permite-el-uso-temporal-del-campamento-de-migrantes-en-el-puerto-de-ceuta.html">la Audiencia Nacional permitiera su uso</a>, de manera temporal, tras múltiples rifirrafes judiciales y políticos por la utilización de la infraestructura. El inicio del operativo ha estado marcado por el caos de una estampida inicial y la tensión que se ha saldado con disparos de los agentes al aire y varias personas heridas. Los primeros inmigrantes han llegado ya a las instalaciones, que en algunas zonas están aún en obras, donde se les registra a la entrada para la posterior identificación.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-18/tension-y-caos-en-el-traslado-de-los-migrantes-de-la-playa-benitez-al-puerto-de-ceuta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>Como esos supertacañones que defendían que una cosa era la libertad y otra, el libertinaje, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-10/el-supremo-ve-en-la-ley-de-nietos-un-peligro-fundado-real-y-serio-de-afectar-a-las-elecciones.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-10/el-supremo-ve-en-la-ley-de-nietos-un-peligro-fundado-real-y-serio-de-afectar-a-las-elecciones.html">el Supremo —con la salvedad bravísima y triste de la magistrada Alicia Millán, única discrepante— ha dicho que una cosa es votar y otra muy distinta, el <i>voteo</i> al buen tuntún</a>. ¿Qué es eso de que cualquier ciudadano español pueda meter una papeleta en una urna? El derecho al sufragio, señores míos, es algo muy serio. No sabemos qué piensan todos esos nietos de aquella ralea de exiliados. Vaya usted a saber a qué propaganda están sometidos. No a la nuestra, desde luego. Esa gente no sigue las tertulias de la radio. A lo peor, tienen una visión de España filtrada por las batallitas de sus abuelos, enemigos sin matices del franquismo, al que no le verían nada bueno. Viven aturdidos por Bad Bunny y Shakira, no les suena ni un estribillo de Manolo Escobar. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-09-16/aqui-no-puede-votar-cualquiera.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>Alberto Núñez Feijóo ha redoblado su ofensiva para “europeizar” la crisis de Ceuta con una acción triple. Por un lado, el PP español ha promovido que el Parlamento Europeo apruebe este jueves una resolución que <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/la-jueza-busca-quien-coordino-financio-y-decidio-el-operativo-de-la-entrada-masiva-a-ceuta-en-marruecos.html" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/la-jueza-busca-quien-coordino-financio-y-decidio-el-operativo-de-la-entrada-masiva-a-ceuta-en-marruecos.html">responsabiliza a España de la entrada de 70.000 a 80.000 migrantes en Ceuta el 30 y 31 de julio</a> y que lanza además un serio aviso a Rabat, abriendo la puerta a suspender el acuerdo de asociación entre la UE y Marruecos. Por otro, el líder del PP se ha reunido este jueves en Madrid con el comisario de Inmigración, Magnus Brunner, a quien ha pedido que la UE medie en el “retorno inmediato” de todos los inmigrantes que permanecen en Ceuta. Y, por último, el jefe de la oposición ha publicado un artículo en uno de los medios más influyentes en Bruselas, <a href="https://www.politico.eu/article/in-ceuta-its-up-to-europe-to-clean-up-the-spanish-governments-mess/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://www.politico.eu/article/in-ceuta-its-up-to-europe-to-clean-up-the-spanish-governments-mess/"><i>Politico</i></a>, en el que reclama directamente a la UE que tome cartas en el asunto y “solucione el desastre provocado por el Gobierno español en Ceuta”. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/feijoo-presiona-a-bruselas-para-que-se-involucre-en-la-crisis-de-ceuta-ante-el-fracaso-del-gobierno.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>El Parlamento Europeo intenta tener protagonismo en la agenda de política exterior. El PP español ha tirado esa palanca para atacar al Gobierno, algo que ya es casi una tradición en Bruselas: la Eurocámara ha aprobado este jueves una resolución, presentada por el PP europeo con el patrocinio del PP español, que ha salido adelante con el apoyo general de las derechas, más algunos liberales de Renew, y el voto en contra de los socialistas europeos, los verdes y la izquierda. Esa resolución <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/la-jueza-busca-quien-coordino-financio-y-decidio-el-operativo-de-la-entrada-masiva-a-ceuta-en-marruecos.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/la-jueza-busca-quien-coordino-financio-y-decidio-el-operativo-de-la-entrada-masiva-a-ceuta-en-marruecos.html">responsabiliza a España de la entrada de unos 80.000 migrantes en Ceuta en los días de julio</a>. Afea las “reiteradas advertencias” de los servicios de seguridad e inteligencia, en contra de los argumentos del Gobierno. Y con una abrumadora mayoría (339 votos a favor, 225 en contra y 16 abstenciones), la Eurocámara lanza además un serio aviso a Rabat: la derecha europea abre la puerta a suspender el acuerdo de asociación entre la UE y Marruecos, que supone fondos multimillonarios para Rabat a cambio de proteger la frontera.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/las-derechas-europeas-cargan-contra-espana-por-la-crisis-de-ceuta-y-lanzan-una-advertencia-a-marruecos.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: La Eurocámara amaga con suspender el acuerdo de asociación con Marruecos, que supone cientos de millones de euros a cambio de proteger la frontera

articles.body: <p>La Audiencia Nacional ha rechazado finalmente la suspensión cautelarísima solicitada por el Sindicato Unificado de la Policía (SUP) y permite que siga adelante <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-16/la-audiencia-nacional-frena-el-campamento-para-migrantes-en-el-puerto-de-ceuta-tras-la-denuncia-de-un-sindicato-policial.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-16/la-audiencia-nacional-frena-el-campamento-para-migrantes-en-el-puerto-de-ceuta-tras-la-denuncia-de-un-sindicato-policial.html">la ocupación de 16.000 metros cuadrados de la ampliación de Poniente del Puerto de Ceuta para instalar un campamento</a> en el que alojar a parte de los migrantes que entraron en la ciudad autónoma en el salto masivo de los pasados 30 y 31 de julio. El tribunal justifica su decisión ―que supone que el Gobierno pueda continuar con sus planes para trasladar a este recinto a cerca de 1.800 migrantes que aún permanecen acampados en la playa de El Trampolín y que habían quedado paralizados solo unas horas antes por el mismo órgano judicial― en que “concurren razones de interés general que justifican el otorgamiento de la autorización solicitada” para levantar las instalaciones de acogida. La resolución no admite recurso.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/la-audiencia-nacional-permite-el-uso-temporal-del-campamento-de-migrantes-en-el-puerto-de-ceuta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/WIO5JPZWKJCAFHFPTK5C56NEVI.JPG?auth=860bc96fa27282d5d57c49d089601bf30ebda9f0b7d11a659a14065f03d42e67" width="7769" height="5182" alt="Migrantes en las chozas de la playa de El Trampolín a la espera del nuevo campamento temporal del muelle de Poniente del puerto de Ceuta."></img>
articles.headline: La Audiencia Nacional permite el uso temporal del campamento de migrantes en el puerto de Ceuta

articles.body: <p>“Ceuta les importa un bledo”. “Se les debería caer la cara de vergüenza por poner palos en la rueda”. Con estas duras palabras ha denunciado el ministro de Transportes, Óscar Puente, lo que considera una campaña orquestada contra el Gobierno para, a su juicio, prolongar la crisis en Ceuta tras la entrada masiva de migrantes los últimos días de julio. “El Gobierno de la nación está luchando contra un montón de agentes que lo que quieren es que esto no se solucione, es decir, que lo que quieren es que esto se enquiste”, ha criticado tras <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-16/el-gobierno-muestra-su-perplejidad-por-el-freno-de-la-audiencia-nacional-al-campamento-para-migrantes-del-puerto-de-ceuta.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-16/el-gobierno-muestra-su-perplejidad-por-el-freno-de-la-audiencia-nacional-al-campamento-para-migrantes-del-puerto-de-ceuta.html">el freno el miércoles de la Audiencia Nacional al campamento en el puerto ceutí</a> que prevé alojar a más de 1.000 inmigrantes que se encuentran todavía en las calles de la ciudad autónoma y en referencia también a la negativa del PP de trasladar a menores a la Península. Es, en su opinión, “el <i>modus operandi</i> habitual del Partido Popular cada vez que hay una crisis”. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/puente-denuncia-una-campana-para-frenar-las-soluciones-en-ceuta-se-iba-a-trasladar-hoy-a-1800-migrantes.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Puente denuncia una campaña para frenar las soluciones en Ceuta: “Se iba a trasladar hoy a 1.800 migrantes”

articles.body: <p>La ministra de Defensa, Margarita Robles, ha reiterado este jueves que Ceuta y Melilla “son la mejor España”, y ha asegurado que las Fuerzas Armadas van a estar siempre en las dos ciudades españolas del Norte de África defendiendo sus valores, “que son la convivencia, la tolerancia y el respeto”. Robles ha pronunciado estas palabras de la clausura de la tercera edición de los Diálogos para la Seguridad, organizadas por EL PAÍS, en el Centro Superior de Estudios de Defensa (Ceseden). Por la mañana ha visitado en el hospital Gómez Ulla a los dos soldados que han sido evacuados de Ceuta tras sufrir sendas fracturas —de las que uno de ellos ha tenido que ser intervenido— durante un presunto ataque por parte de inmigrantes.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/robles-afirma-que-el-ejercito-defendera-siempre-la-convivencia-la-tolerancia-y-el-respeto-en-ceuta-y-melilla.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Robles afirma que el Ejército defenderá siempre “la convivencia, la tolerancia y el respeto” en Ceuta y Melilla

Ana María Fuentes, gerente del PSOE, descargó en la figura que ejercía Santos Cerdán toda responsabilidad <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-31/el-juez-pedraz-autoriza-a-rastrear-seis-cuentas-del-psoe-en-busca-de-pagos-a-leire-diez-y-otros-imputados.html" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-07-31/el-juez-pedraz-autoriza-a-rastrear-seis-cuentas-del-psoe-en-busca-de-pagos-a-leire-diez-y-otros-imputados.html">sobre los pagos del partido a los implicados en el llamado <i>caso Leire Díez</i></a><i>. </i>Así consta en una grabación, a la que ha tenido acceso EL PAÍS, que recoge la declaración que prestó como investigada ante el juez Santiago Pedraz en la Audiencia Nacional el pasado 9 de septiembre. Aquel día, la trabajadora de Ferraz defendió que el partido contratase abogados externos para afrontar sus “frentes jurídicos”, pero descargó en Cerdán la decisión de fichar a los letrados Jacobo Teijelo e Ismael Oliver, también investigados en la causa. “El secretario de Organización tiene plenas facultades, puede contratar un servicio y un contrato verbal”.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/la-gerente-del-psoe-atribuyo-a-cerdan-los-encargos-a-los-imputados-del-caso-leire-diez-tiene-poder-para-cualquier-accion.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>“Ceuta y Melilla son España, pero son también Unión Europea y ahí es donde deben estar y <a href="https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-09-16/von-der-leyen-endurece-su-discurso-sobre-migracion-a-raiz-de-la-crisis-de-ceuta.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-09-16/von-der-leyen-endurece-su-discurso-sobre-migracion-a-raiz-de-la-crisis-de-ceuta.html">van a estar Ceuta y Melilla</a>, en el corazón de la Unión Europea”, ha defendido este jueves el ministro de Exteriores, José Manuel Albares, durante su intervención en la tercera edición de <i>Diálogos para la Seguridad</i>, un evento organizado por EL PAÍS, y que gira en torno al rol de Europa en un mundo atravesado por turbulencias. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/albares-ceuta-y-melilla-van-a-estar-en-el-corazon-de-la-union-europea.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/FJH23SQK25CFLET7I7IRIAVIWQ.jpg?auth=abc46e1941016cbd2e3f23caff6a5583b5e9a3a4cea10ac9df106fc02346a7e7" width="6000" height="3484" alt="El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores, José Manuel Albares, este jueves en la jornada ‘Diálogos para la Seguridad’."></img>

articles.body: <p>El Gobierno insiste en sus aspiraciones de devolver a Marruecos los miles de migrantes llegados a Ceuta, salvo aquellos que puedan permanecer en base al derecho internacional. Bajo esa premisa, La Moncloa ha solicitado este jueves a Bruselas instrumentos que permitan “acelerar” los retornos en crisis extraordinarias como la de la ciudad autónoma. La petición se ha producido durante una reunión del ministro de Interior, Fernando Grande-Marlaska, y la ministra de Inclusión, Seguridad Social y Migraciones, Elma Saiz, mantenida en Madrid con el comisario del ramo, Magnus Brunner, <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/puente-denuncia-una-campana-para-frenar-las-soluciones-en-ceuta-se-iba-a-trasladar-hoy-a-1800-migrantes.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/puente-denuncia-una-campana-para-frenar-las-soluciones-en-ceuta-se-iba-a-trasladar-hoy-a-1800-migrantes.html">en el marco de la emergencia ceutí</a>. El encuentro ha ocurrido un día después de que la presidenta de la Comisión, Ursula von der Leyen, <a href="https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-09-16/von-der-leyen-endurece-su-discurso-sobre-migracion-a-raiz-de-la-crisis-de-ceuta.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-09-16/von-der-leyen-endurece-su-discurso-sobre-migracion-a-raiz-de-la-crisis-de-ceuta.html">propusiera ante el Parlamento Europeo</a> una nueva regulación que permitiría a los Estados miembros suspender —“flexibilizar”, según dijo— las reglas migratorias ante situaciones como la sufrida en suelo ceutí.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-17/marlaska-pide-a-bruselas-acelerar-los-procedimientos-de-retorno-en-crisis-migratorias-como-la-de-ceuta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: L’alcalde de Barcelona, Jaume Collboni, ha anunciat mesures per protegir els comerços de la ciutat de les pujades dels lloguers dels locals . L’Ajuntament ja feia temps que estudiava la forma d’ajudar els establiments comercials en risc per l’increment del preu dels arrendaments , sobretot després del degoteig de tancaments de botigues històriques dels últims mesos . Finalment, s’ha confirmat que, tal com va plantejar Collboni al juliol , Barcelona tindrà un fons per rescatar establiments comercials emblemàtics en risc de desaparèixer. D’aquesta manera, el consistori podrà adquirir els locals d’establiments emblemàtics o també estratègics per al barri i que es consideri que s’han de preservar. La mesura es posarà en marxa abans que acabi l’any i també durant el darrer trimestre es farà alguna operació en aquest sentit. Objectiu: que els ajuntaments tinguin dret a tanteig i retracte Per fer-ho possible, però, calen eines i la intenció és que no només Barcelona pugui protegir el comerç de proximitat. Per això, Collboni també ha anunciat una segona iniciativa conjunta amb la Generalitat : la posada en marxa d’un grup de treball que estudiarà i impulsarà les modificacions legislatives necessàries perquè tots els ajuntaments puguin exercir el dret a tanteig i retracte dels locals comercials que es consideri que s’han de salvar. En paraules de Collboni, això ha de permetre “intervenir especialment en aquells comerços que per les seves característiques històriques o pel paper que tenen en un eix comercial o en un barri s’han de preservar”. Aquest model, diuen, en tot cas s’ha de desenvolupar de manera “quirúrgica” i requereix intervenir en casos concrets. “Estem parlant de llocs de treball, de cohesió social, de relacions humanes, de la identitat de les nostres ciutats. De caminar pels carrers i reconèixer-nos en allò que passa als nostres carrers i per tant de les identitats dels nostres països”, ha dit l’alcalde. També et pot interessar Retrocés al comerç tradicional: Barcelona perd 1 de cada 4 merceries, drogueries i peixateries Jessica Moreno Cusac 3 minuts de lectura Un fòrum per impulsar el comerç local a Europa Tot plegat s’ha anunciat en la inauguració del Fòrum Europeu de les Ciutats i del Comerç de Proximitat , al Palau de Pedralbes, davant de la secretària d’Estat de Comerç, Amparo López; el vicepresident del Parlament Europeu, Javi López, i el conseller d’Empresa de la Generalitat de Catalunya, Miquel Sàmper. La trobada vol ser un espai de reflexió i anàlisi sobre el paper del comerç local a les ciutats europees. Està organitzat per la Generalitat, se celebra en el marc de la Capitalitat Europea del Comerç Local , que ostenta Barcelona, i aplega institucions, experts, associacions de comerciants i agents d’arreu d’Europa que compartiran experiències i visions dels principals reptes del sector . L’objectiu és també posar en relleu el valor del comerç de proximitat des dels punts de vista econòmic, social i urbà, i s’hi abordarà també el paper de les polítiques públiques i de la col·laboració publicoprivada.

articles.body: Intel·ligència Romàntica , el nou treball d’Ani in the Hall, defineix amb precisió la identitat d’aquesta formació catalana: una fusió entre arrels tradicionals i eines contemporànies on els cants rituals es barregen amb capes sintètiques. La veu d’ Aina Serena guia un discurs que oscil·la entre el teatre, la màgia i l’absurd. Cantades completament en català, les lletres deformen contes i cançons del folklore tradicional sobre una base percussionada que connecta la tradició polifònica mediterrània amb el minimalisme dels Estats Units. D’esperit avantguardista però amb una ànima clarament pop, el duet estrena al Sónar 2026 un espectacle en directe que aposta per la sobrietat, la sensibilitat i el retorn a la potència de les arrels. articles.body: (ACN) Irídia, Òmnium Cultural i l’Assemblea Nacional Catalana (ANC) han denunciat aquest divendres una “ vulneració de drets lingüístics ” i una “ falta de transparència ” durant el judici contra els agents acusats de mutilar un ull a Roger Español durant els fets de l’1-O . En un comunicat conjunt, signat també per la campanya “#JustíciaPerRoger”, les entitats han titllat d’intolerable que els advocats s’hagin vist obligats a autotraduir-se al castellà davant la incapacitat de la intèrpret . A més, han criticat les restriccions d’aforament i el fet que no es permeti seguir la vista telemàticament , un format que recorden que sí que s’ha habilitat en altres causes judicials rellevants. Expliquen que la situació vulnera la Carta de drets lingüístics de la ciutadania davant la justícia i la Llei orgànica del poder judicial. També et pot interessar Comença el judici contra els policies que van mutilar Roger Español en les càrregues de l’1-O Marina Sancho Núria Granados 4 minuts de lectura Denuncien que el judici és opac En el manifest, Irídia, Òmnium i l’ANC han expressat la seva estupefacció per l'” opacitat ” que envolta el judici, tot i ser “d’elevada transcendència social”. L’escrit subratlla que aquesta manca de facilitats afecta directament la tasca de seguiment que estan duent a terme diversos observadors internacionals de drets humans desplaçats a Barcelona. Per tot plegat, les entitats han exigit a l’estament judicial que corregeixi “de manera urgent” aquestes deficiències, garanteixi el respecte ple als drets lingüístics de les parts i permeti el desenvolupament del judici amb la màxima transparència. articles.body: La Cursa de la Mercè 2026 a Barcelona tornarà a aplegar milers de corredors populars coincidint amb les Festes de la Mercè. La competició tindrà un recorregut atractiu, que ja es va inaugurar l’any passat, i que ha de permetre més fluïdesa amb sortida al carrer d’Aragó i arribada a la plaça de Catalunya. Enguany, hi podran prendre part 17.200 corredors . Et detallem tot el que has de saber sobre la Cursa de la Mercè 202 6 a Barcelona : dates, recorregut, inscripcions i dorsals . I recorda!: ho podràs seguir en directe a betevé . Què vols saber sobre la Cursa de la Mercè 2026 a Barcelona? Data de la cursa de la Mercè 2026 Recorregut de la cursa de la Mercè Com serà cursa de la Mercè 2026? Inscripcions per la Cursa de la Mercè 2026 Recollida de dorsals per la Cursa de la Mercè Cursa de la Mercè inclusiva Cursa de la Mercè 2026: dia i hora La Cursa de la Mercè 2026 serà el diumenge 20 de setembre, a partir de les 8.30 h . La sortida serà al carrer d’Aragó i l’arribada, a la plaça de Catalunya. Recorregut de la cursa de la Mercè 2026 El recorregut de la Cursa de la Mercè 2026 torna a repetir el dissenys creat pel 2025 . El circuit té la sortida al carrer d’Aragó i l’arribada a la plaça de Catalunya . Seran 10 quilòmetres amb un circuit nou, atractiu i amb avingudes àmplies i espai per córrer , fetque afavorirà que no hi hagi aglomeracions. L’itinerari és el següent: Inici:  c. Aragó a prop de c. Pau Claris. Itinerari:  c. Aragó a prop de c. Pau Claris, fins a av. Roma; gir a la dreta al c. Casanova i, de nou, gir a la dreta al c. València fins a pg. Sant Joan; gir a la dreta fins a pg. Lluís Companys; baixar pel lateral dret en sentit de la marxa; gir a la dreta al c. Pujades i, tot seguit, gir a l’esquerra a pg. Picasso fins a av. Marquès d’Argentera; gir a la dreta fins al pg. d’Isabel II, pg. Colom i fins a la rotonda de pl. Drassanes; gir a la dreta per agafar l’av. Paral·lel fins fer gir a la dreta al c. Entença; gir a la dreta al c. Floridablanca, gir a l’esquerra a la ronda de Sant Antoni i pl. Universitat; gir a la dreta al c. Pelai, gir a l’esquerra a pl. Catalunya i punt d’arribada a prop del c. Bergara. Final:  pl. Catalunya. Com serà la cursa de la Mercè? L’organització vol superar els 14.500 corredors de l’edició del 2025 i arribar a una xifra de 17.200 participants en totes les proves de la cursa ( 16.000 a la prova de 10 quilòmetres més la milla familiar i  la cursa inclusiva de 2 km). També et pot interessar L’atractiu recorregut de la Cursa de la Mercè Inici al carrer d’Aragó i final a la Plaça de Catalunya Inscripcions per a la Cursa de la Mercè 2026 Les inscripcions de la Cursa de la Mercè es van obrir el passat 23 de juny i buscan assolir la xifra de 17.200 participants (16.000 per la de 10 quilòmetres i 1.200 per a la milla familiar). Aquestes es poden fer mitjançant el lloc web de la prova . El preu de la prova, com és habitual, és de només 5 € si es disposa de xip groc propi, o de 7 € si no se’n disposa i se’n lloga un de blanc. La recaptació anirà destinada a fins benèfics, igual que els últims anys. En aquest 2026 és per a Pallassos sense Fronteres . Recollida de dorsals per a la Cursa de la Mercè A l’hora de fer la inscripció, s’ha de posar quan es recollirà el dorsal i la samarreta a la Fira del Corredor (Pavelló d’Itàlia, a la plaça Carles Buïgas). Hi haurà quatre franges disponibles . Per recollir els dorsal és indispensable el comprovant, ja sigui en paper o en format digital. dijous 17 de setembre, d’15 h a 19 h divendres, 18 de setembre, de 10 h a 15 h divendres, 18 de setembre, de 15 a 19 h dissabte, 19 de setembre, de 10 h a 15 h dissabte, 19 de setembre, de 15 h a 19 h També et pot interessar Curses a Barcelona 2026-27: Calendari, mapa i recorreguts de les proves esportives a la ciutat Carles Alcoyent Corominas Eva Vial Raúl Muñoz Hernández 20 minuts de lectura Cursa Familiar La 48a edició de la Cursa de la Mercè, que ha continuat amb l’acord d’ esponsorització amb Bimbo , continua amb l’oferta esportiva que va estrenar en l’edició del 2025. A més de les modalitats de 10 km i 2 km, la Cursa de la Mercè  afegeix una versió familiar, no competitiva i oberta a tothom qui hi vulgui participar amb familiars ,   amb places limitades (1.000) i a un preu de tres euros. Aquesta serà d’una milla (1.609 metres) i les inscripcions també es fan al lloc de la Cursa de la Mercè . La prova començarà a les 10.45 h i acabarà al voltant de les 11.15 h. Recorregut: Inici: pl. Catalunya. Itinerari: pl. Catalunya, c. Pelai, pl. Universitat, ronda Sant Antoni fins passat c. Joaquín Costa, on hi ha un gir de 360 º per retornar pel mateix circuit fins a pl. Catalunya. Final: pl. Catalunya. Cursa de la Mercè inclusiva La 2K Mercè 2025 és una carrera inclusiva de dos quilòmetres , cohesionada amb la principal de 10 quilòmetres. Hi podran prendre part persones amb discapacitat intel·lectual o amb mobilitat reduïda que, per condició física, no poden córrer una distància de 10 quilòmetres. Aquesta cursa és gratuïta . Sortida: entre 9.15 h i 9.30 h (quan el volum de corredors ho permeti. L’hora de concentració serà a les 9 h). Inscripcions: enviant un correu electrònic a  merce@lasansi.com Recorregut: Inici: xamfrà c. Tamarit amb c. Entença. Itinerari : xamfrà c. Tamarit amb c. Entença, gir a la dreta per incorporar-se al c. Rocafort (incorporació a la cursa de 10 km) fins gir a la dreta al c. Floridablanca, gir a l’esquerra a la ronda Sant Antoni, pl. Universitat, gir a la dreta al c. Pelai, gir a l’esquerra i arribada a pl. Catalunya. Final : pl. Catalunya.

articles.body: L’alcalde de Barcelona, Jaume Collboni , viatjarà aquest cap de setmana als Estats Units d’Amèrica per participar en la cimera Urban20 . És la cita prèvia a la trobada del G20 (que reuneix les principals potències econòmiques del món), amb la diferència que en l’Urban20 hi ha representades les ciutats i no els estats. Durant el viatge als EUA, Collboni es trobarà amb l’ alcalde de Nova York, el demòcrata Zohran Mamdani . Va assumir l’alcaldia novaiorquesa el novembre del 2025 i és un dels càrrecs públics dels EUA que s’han oposat més fermament a les polítiques del president estatunidenc, el republicà Donald Trump . Mamdani, a més, és el primer alcalde de Nova York de confessió musulmana. Fa només unes setmanes, Collboni també va mantenir una reunió amb el president d’Ucraïna, Volodímir Zelenski , durant el viatge que va fer per l’est d’Europa: Sarajevo (Bòsnia i Hercegovina), Varsòvia (Polònia) i Kíiv (Ucraïna). També et pot interessar Trump tallarà “tot el comerç amb Espanya” per la posició de Sánchez amb la guerra a l’Iran Redacció 2 minuts de lectura L’habitatge a les ciutats Més enllà de la trobada a porta tancada amb el seu homòleg local, Jaume Collboni també tindrà un paper destacat durant la celebració de l’Urban20, en la sessió que tindrà lloc aquest diumenge. L’alcalde barceloní encapçalarà una jornada centrada en habitatge a les ciutats , d’on en sortirà un document de conclusions que es lliurarà als presidents dels estats. Pocs dies després de la visita de Collboni a Nova York, el president del Govern espanyol, Pedro Sánchez , també serà a la ciutat estatunidenca per participar en l’Assemblea General de les Nacions Unides. El president espanyol també compartirà un acte amb Zohran Mamdani. Si et pica la curiositat… Per què no neva a Barcelona i sí a Nova York? Marcos Amores Sánchez 3 minuts de lectura

articles.body: Aquest 2026 està sent especialment negre per al col·lectiu dels motoristes. Des que va començar l’any ja han mort sis motoristes en accidents de trànsit a Barcelona, d’un total de 13 víctimes mortals . No només representen gairebé la meitat de les morts en accident a la ciutat, sinó que el nombre de víctimes dalt d’una moto ja supera la xifra total de tot l’any passat , quan van perdre la vida cinc motoristes . L’última víctima, Guim Cifré, un dels promotors del JazzSí, va morir en un accident de moto aquest dimecres a les Corts . Els altres accidents mortals van ser el 9 de gener , el 21 de febrer , el 25 de febrer , el 15 de maig i el 31 d’agost . També et pot interessar Accidents mortals a Barcelona: on i quan es produeixen els sinistres de trànsit a la ciutat? | MAPA Eva Vial 4 minuts de lectura El col·lectiu amb més víctimes mortals No és la primera vegada que els motoristes encapçalen el còmput de víctimes mortals en accidents de trànsit. De fet, els últims 12 anys ho han fet un total de vuit vegades: 2014, 2015, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 i 2024 . El 2025, en canvi, tot i que van perdre la vida cinc motoristes, els vianants van ser el grup amb més accidents mortals. Al conjunt de Catalunya, els accidents mortals de moto també representen un terç del total. Així, de les 95 víctimes d’aquest any en accident de trànsit, 36 circulaven en motocicleta. També et pot interessar Ets testimoni d’un accident avui? Explica-ho a betevé Redacció 1 minut de lectura El 30 % dels desplaçaments a Barcelona, en moto Justament reduir els accidents de moto és un dels objectius de l’Observatori de la Moto , creat l’octubre del 2025 i del qual formen part el col·lectiu de motoristes, els fabricants, les associacions de prevenció d’accidents i l’Ajuntament de Barcelona. Entre els reptes que es plantegen hi ha reduir els accidents greus i amb víctimes a la meitat l’any 2050 , i es volen analitzar els llocs amb més sinistres de la ciutat. Actualment a Barcelona hi ha censades 274.000 motos i representen el 30 % dels desplaçaments en vehicle privat a la ciutat. articles.body: La pluja torna a visitar la ciutat de Barcelona aquest divendres. Una nova descàrrega d’aire fred en altura ha propiciat la formació de xàfecs puntualment forts que van lliscant la costa i que toquen terra als barris més propers al mar de la ciutat de Barcelona. També et pot interessar Ruixats forts damunt del mar: divendres insegur a primeres hores Manel Cascante Torrella 1 minut de lectura És la traca final Entre el matí i el migdia encara hi haurà la possibilitat de xàfecs puntualment intensos. El Meteocat manté un avís activat davant aquesta possibilitat. Els xàfecs descarregaran majoritàriament damunt del mar, però podrien tocar terra en algun moment a qualsevol punt del litoral barceloní. Pluja puntualment intensa . Les clarianes augmentaran a partir del migdia i donaran pas a una tarda força més assolellada. Ambient fresc, típic de principis de tardor. El cap de setmana serà molt tranquil i el sol s’imposarà de nou, juntament amb un augment clar de la temperatura. Tornarà la calor al migdia , però moderada. articles.body: Els Mossos d’Esquadra han detingut el presumpte autor dels sis robatoris de coure en els últims 10 dies a l’Estació de França . L’home, de 21 anys, va ser detingut aquest dijous al vespre per la policia i té 14 antecedents. La detenció l’han fet agents de la Unitat de Seguretat Ciutadana de Ciutat Vella. L’home tenia una ordre de detenció vigent emesa per la Unitat d’Investigació de l’Àrea Regional de Transport Urbà. També et pot interessar Sisè robatori de coure en 10 dies a l’Estació de França: es repeteixen els retards a l’R2 Sud Marta Casals Torres 1 minut de lectura Més vigilància a l’estació Justament aquest mateix dijous els Mossos i la seguretat privada d’Adif van reforçar la vigilància a l’Estació de França per evitar que hi hagués més robatoris de cables de coure, una petició que dies abans ja havien fet les plataformes d’usuaris com Dignitat a les Vies i Afectats per Rodalies , que reclamen més contundència davant d’aquest tipus d’accions, que provoquen alteracions greus del servei de trens. En aquesta mateixa línia, el secretari d’Estat de Transports, José Antonio Santano , va anunciar la setmana passada que s’instal·laran càmeres de vigilància a l’estació —tot i que no s’ha concretat quan— i que s’estava treballant amb els Mossos per poder detenir-ne els autors. També et pot interessar Mossos i seguretat privada reforcen els controls a l’Estació de França per evitar robatoris de coure Redacció 1 minut de lectura Sis robatoris en només 10 dies Aquests darrers robatoris de coure a l’Estació de França han alterat significativament el servei de l’R2 Sud de Rodalies i també els trens regionals del sud i els usuaris han hagut de patir retards constants. L’últim robatori es va produir aquest dimecres, però la setmana passada n’hi va haver un pràcticament cada dia . articles.body: (ACN) La plantilla del telefèric de Barcelona ha anunciat tres dies de vaga parcial, el 24 i 26 de setembre i l’11 d’octubre . Asseguren que TMB té una actitud immobilista en les negociacions per aconseguir “millores socials i unes condicions laborals més dignes”. La convocatòria, que s’ha fet a través del sindicat Solidaritat Obrera, arribarà només uns dies després de la protesta que faran els treballadors dels autobusos el 22 de setembre entre les 10 i les 17 h per reclamar l’aplicació de la jornada laboral de 35 hores i més descansos. Aturades de dues hores al migdia i a la tarda Les aturades seran de dues hores i afectaran una franja del migdia, de 12.30 a 14.30 h, i una altra de la tarda, de 15.45 a 17.45 h. Les negociacions van començar, segons relata la plantilla en un comunicat, el gener del 2025 i ara consideren que la situació ha arribat a un punt insostenible. Entre d’altres, la plantilla denuncia precarietat en el lloc de treball i unes condicions laborals no adequades a les responsabilitats, les exigències i les característiques del servei que presten. En aquest sentit, el col·lectiu lamenta que, en alguns aspectes, aquestes condicions “fins i tot han empitjorat”, en lloc de millorar. Per això, l’objectiu de la mobilització és aconseguir unes condicions laborals “més justes i dignes” , desbloquejar les negociacions i aconseguir que l’empresa “assumeixi la necessitat d’abordar de manera seriosa i efectiva les reivindicacions de la plantilla”.
